en: The postcard features a collage of illustrated views of landmarks in a region of Germany. The central image is a tall stone tower (Friedrich-August-Turm on Rochlitzer Berg). Surrounding it are depictions of: Schloss Rochsburg (a castle on a hill), Göhrener Brücke (a large arched railway viaduct/bridge), Schloss Rochlitz (another castle by water with twin towers), and Schloss und Kirche Wechselburg (a castle and church together in a rural setting). The images are captioned in German.
